claim: The working comparator image has NO usable room at all. Adding even eleven lines of code blocks to mbir_cmp_lt.hell makes LMAO fail with 'HeLL program overlaps with generated initialization code' -- a placement conflict, not a size problem. Its 1,537-byte margin is entirely consumed by the initializer, so the verbatim-base route cannot absorb the decimal reader at any size.
claim_status: NOT_DEMONSTRATED (base image has zero usable room)
four_failure_modes_measured_on_this_rout: 43 lines added -> 'Cannot generate initialization code for cell 58998' (51 cells short)
36 lines added -> 'Cannot generate jump to entry point 57737'
36 lines minimised -> 'Memory usage conflict while generating initialization code' (generic)
11 lines added -> 'HeLL program overlaps with generated initialization code' (placement conflict)
reading: the failure mode changes with the amount added but never clears. At the smallest tested addition it is a placement conflict, which means the base's margin is fully occupied by the initializer and there is no address at which the added block can be placed.
convergent_conclusion: E1 cannot be built by extending the working comparator image: it has no usable room. It cannot be built on a from-scratch layout either, because the position-dependent opcode decode misroutes the entry (measured: IN at step 6483 in the working image versus HALT at 6484 in the from-scratch one). Both routes are now measured.
what_would_be_needed: A program designed for the 5+2 cycle technique from the start, where the layout, the entry route and the cycle cells are designed together -- not grafted onto either existing image.
what_is_demonstrated: The verbatim-base technique transfers the layout and entry wiring intact (zero structural errors at every addition size tested).
The 5+2 technique needs no new cells on this base: LOOP5 is a cycle of 5 and any flag is a cycle of 2.
The base image has zero usable room: even eleven lines conflict with the initializer.
scope_limits: Additions from 11 to 43 lines were tested; a leaner encoding below eleven lines was not searched.
